family_statistic: maximum normalized squared complex projection over the three frozen long periods
permutation_control: independently permute each signal within each section, preserving section marginals and canonical carrier positions
random_period_control: maximum over three distinct uniform integer periods in the frozen 761..3301 range
phase_note: A constant selector-derived phase multiplies a complex projection by a unit-magnitude scalar, so squared magnitude is exactly invariant. Selector phases are audited for equality and are not counted as independent models.
